The '''Erilnar system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Centrality/Legends|Centrality]], a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Erilnar]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the Centrality.
